name: Kanban Pro
headline: Keep the whole team on the same board
summary: Plan work in shared kanban boards. Create workspaces, invite teammates, assign cards, and see changes together in real time.

benefits.title: See work move
benefits.body: Drag cards across customizable columns as priorities change.

benefits.title: Work together live
benefits.body: Presence indicators show who is viewing the board, while changes sync across connected browsers.

benefits.title: Give every task an owner
benefits.body: Assign teammates to cards and keep status, ETA, requirements, and acceptance criteria close to the work.

howItWorks.title: Create a workspace
howItWorks.body: Set up a board for your team and invite members with a shareable link.

howItWorks.title: Add and assign cards
howItWorks.body: Organize tasks in columns and assign each card to a teammate.

howItWorks.title: Follow progress
howItWorks.body: Move cards as work advances and see updates appear live.
